newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank repo average yield rises to 19.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank repo average yield rises to 19.50 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Thursday rose to 19.50 percent from 9.38 percent on Tuesday, the NBS said in a statement.
The central bank offered a maximum 1.0 billion crowns.
Overall bids totalled 4.450 billion crowns. The average, maximum and minimum yields were at 19.50 percent which, dealers said, indicated that only one bank's bids were accepted in the tender.
The NBS did not hold a repo tender on Wednesday. Average yield in its one-week repo tender fell to 9.38 percent on Tuesday, from 17.25 percent in a similar repo on Monday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 16 lacked 5.97 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
